mathematics.assertion_tested: Minimizing W=K/(1+a*y)+m_squared*y/2+lambda*y^2/4 at fixed canonical kinetic density gives a power-law high-density affine-family pressure, not a logarithmic EOS; scalar branch stability does not guarantee reduced positive compressibility.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Positive real parameters; exact rational symbolic identities and IEEE double precision finite checks
mathematics.conventions: y=chi^2>=0; K is canonical random kinetic density. Density pressure is derived only along canonical affine dilation x->b*x,p->p/b, for which K=k*rho^(5/3) at fixed k. Scalar is minimized locally and gradients, dynamics, and gravity are omitted.
non_claims: Not a halo or cosmological evolution
Not a full coupled stability theorem
Not exclusion of a short-range fitted logotropic approximation
